items.title: Interview: How Cyberpunk 2077's Night City Was Built Almost Entirely by Hand
items.excerpt: CD PROJEKT RED's art directors explain how Night City was handcrafted building by building: procedural tools were tested and rejected for quality reasons, leaving only a road-placement tool that artists still adjusted by hand afterwards. They also cover how first-person framing set the level of detail and why path tracing suited the lighting pipeline.
items.why: 현재 게임 업계의 절차적/AI 자동 생성 논쟁 한복판에서, AAA 오픈월드가 왜 수작업을 고수했는지 아트 디렉터가 직접 설명한 워크플로 사례.

items.title: You can now apply DLSS 5 to your entire desktop with a free app and it even works with RTX 30-series cards
items.excerpt: A free app pipes DLSS 5 neural rendering across the whole Windows desktop — including video and photos, not just games — and it runs on RTX 30-series cards as well.
items.why: 뉴럴 렌더링이 게임 엔진 밖으로 나와 데스크톱 전체 이미지·영상에 적용되는 단계 — 아티스트의 레퍼런스/캡처 워크플로까지 영향권에 들어온다.

items.title: Breaking Benjamin's singer is begging concertgoers to try his AI-assisted first-person Fallout 4 mod
items.excerpt: Breaking Benjamin singer Benjamin Burnley has begged concertgoers to try an AI-assisted first-person mod he's made for Fallout 4, after the mod drew criticism inside the modding community for its use of AI.
items.why: 모드 커뮤니티에서 'AI 보조 제작물'이 어떻게 수용/거부되는지 보여주는 사례 — 개인 제작자의 AI 사용 공개와 평판 관리 문제.

items.title: Writers use AI and distrust it, even when the words are their own, Medium report says
items.excerpt: A new Medium study finds a majority of writers now use AI in their process, yet most of them distrust AI-written work — including readers' suspicion of text the writers actually wrote themselves.
items.why: 창작자가 AI를 쓰면서도 결과물을 불신하는 이중 구조 — 게임 내러티브/기획 문서 작성 현장의 신뢰 비용을 수치로 보여준다.
